name: Blue Dragon’s Imitating Voice
body:
You gain the blue dragon’s ability to imitate sounds.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic bloodline (must choose blue dragon), 1st-level dragon disciple

Benefit: You can mimic any voice or sound you have heard by making a successful Bluff check against a listener’s Sense Motive check. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to Bluff checks when imitating another voice or sound.
